name: ESP32-C5
scope: Logical GPIO, standard UART/I2C/SPI, LEDC channels, ADC1, RMT channels, I2S and the fixed USB Serial/JTAG pads. The ESP32-C5 has a single 6-channel ADC1 (no ADC2), no USB OTG and no SDMMC host; TWAI cannot be enabled in ESP-IDF v5.4 (SOC_TWAI_SUPPORTED is disabled) so it is not modelled. Package/SiP variants and the LP-domain controllers (LP UART / LP I2C) are not fully checked.
